text:
Maya Rivera: Drafted a short customer-facing "bootcamp" one-pager for go-live. Focused on preflight checks, seed probing, batching presets, streaming fallback, and a short shadow plan. Posting here for quick edits before adding to enablement kit: https://confluence.local/r/cs-bootcamp-alpha (draft)
Santiago Lopez: Love the one-pager. Can we add a clear TTL recommendation for seed keys? We had a customer where seeds expired and caused a repeat cold start.
Priya Patel: Recommendation from CS ops: seed TTL = 8m for heavy generation, 45s for conversational turn context. Eviction: LRU, max_entries=8k/tenant. Note: shorter TTL helps memory but increases reseed frequency.
Noah Kim: Telemetry we should require in the guide: `bootstrap:init`, `seed:started`, `seed:ok`, `seed:error`, `bootstrap:done`, `bootstrap:p95_ms`. We'll use these to mark renewal-risk if bootstrap duration > 10m or seed_error_rate > 0.15.
Jen O'Neil: Customer-facing wording: avoid "cache miss". Use "initial response delay" or "warmup in progress". Include suggested copy for emails/alerts.
Carlos M.: Ops run plan: 20m walkthrough with customer CS, then 30m live shadow while sampling first 500 reqs. Engineering buddy volunteers? @Santiago can take first shift.
Santiago Lopez: I can shadow the first 90m. Also adding a tiny probe set called `seed_set_alpha` with 12 probes (3 short prompts, 6 mid, 3 long) that exercise KV hits, prefix cache, and streaming. Will upload examples.
Maya Rivera: I'll include `seed_set_alpha` and a curl snippet customers can run to trigger seeding from their side. Example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/bootstrap
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"customer":"acme-inc","seed_set":"seed_set_alpha","region":"us-west-2"}'
```
Priya Patel: Batching presets for the doc: chat UX -> batch_window_ms=15, max_batch_size=32. High-throughput generation -> batch_window_ms=60, max_batch_size=256. Call out expected median latency tradeoffs and guidance to tune by observing p50/p95 after 1k requests.
Noah Kim: Streaming fallback guidance: prefer streaming=true for end-user UX. If the runtime falls back to non-streaming under load, configure `fallback_model` and emit metric `stream.fallback.count`. Also add `warning.fallback` event so CS can notify customers gracefully.
Maya Rivera: Escalation triggers to capture in the sheet: bootstrap duration > 20m, seed_error_rate > 15%, p95 latency > 2.5x baseline, or missing telemetry > 90s. CS should open a support ticket and tag SE + oncall, include `bootstrap_trace_id`.
Jen O'Neil: Add adoption/renewal signal: if bootstrap success but 7-day active usage < 35% after go-live, create an adoption task for AMs and schedule enablement follow-up.
onboard-bot: Created page "CS Bootcamp One-pager (alpha)" and assigned Maya Rivera to update with seed set and probes. Due in 72h.
Maya Rivera: Thanks everyone. I'll stitch TTLs, probe list, batching presets, streaming fallback text, telemetry names, and friendly failure messaging into the draft. Will ping for final sign-off tomorrow morning. :rocket:
